hints.title: Gregorian Calendar Rules
hints.text: Days per month follow standard rules: April, June, September, November have 30 days; February varies; all others have 31 days.

hints.title: Leap Year Condition
hints.text: A year is a leap year if it is divisible by 4 and not divisible by 100, or if it is divisible by 400.

hints.title: February Check
hints.text: If month is 2, return 29 for a leap year and 28 otherwise. For any other month, return the fixed month day count.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: There are no complex edge cases beyond the leap year modular arithmetic.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constant time table lookup or branching requires zero auxiliary memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should know the exact leap year divisibility rule.
complexity.notes: Century years must be divisible by 400 to qualify as leap years.
